asr.full_text: Hello and welcome to another update video on DOT. So the Polkadot chart remains in a larger downtrend. When we zoom out, you can see that actually it is a higher time frame downtrend as well, which started obviously in 2021. Since then, the market has been unable to rally in an impulse. And so the idea is we are currently working possibly on the late stages of the third wave now or we've already started four. That's not very clear at this point. But the idea is we are probably not done yet with the overall correction. The idea is, in this ABC structure to the downside, you know makes up this third wave the idea was to reach the 100 extension and this was at 1.25 the market is definitely trying to form a low there yeah and for the last few weeks and and even couple of months i've been watching for the start of the wave 4. and I mean yeah you know it moved up like 60 percent nearly but still in context yeah in light of the previous moves this move to the upside so far that that formed there it's pretty insignificant actually especially if you consider the size of the decline before i am watching for still continuation higher in this way for at least as long as the market holds this support area now i can even add the 88.7 retracement you know at 1.16 so we've got levels to watch there around 1.31 1.22 to 1.16 i would expect that they will be reached but bear in mind we don't have a high confidence or high probability bullish setup here because the move to the upside from the february low is a very very clear and i hope we agree it's a very clear three wave move a b c now an abc structure can always turn into a larger abc pattern but not until the b wave is done which also is an abc so i'm tracking three up three down and as long as the market doesn't break decisively below the 1.16 level and sometimes b-wave pullbacks are deep um you know as long as that's not the case as long as we don't break below 1.16 i'm going to watch for five waves up in the c wave but to confirm it that the c wave had started i would need to see at the at the very least a break above this last swing high which formed here around 1.66 yeah this is a first signal line that would need to be broken it's the b wave top and a break above it would be a signal that the c wave up has started i $1.66 this is the first signal line that would need to be broken... It's the B wave top, and a break above it would be a signal that the C wave up has started … Ideally, we form a lower C wave first, and I would expect the market to reach the $1.31 – $1.16 area next. That's just a quick update on DOT, hope you liked the update. Please, if you did, hit the like button, leave a comment and subscribe. If interested in additional update, then check out our membership. Don't forget today we're running our member live session. If you cannot make it, then the recording will be available as well. Thanks so much. Wish you a great day. Bye-bye.
